item.title: metacheck: 7 commits today
item.description:
scienceverse/metacheck

Summary unavailable.

7 commit(s) today:

  • 6518b67 [xml_in_modules] New module peer_review: whether an article's peer review is public and where it can be read (publisher XML, Crossref, Europe PMC, a sentence of the paper), with PubPeer comments on the article itself; open_practices reports the article's licence and declared author contributions; a translation is not stored as a peer review, and SAGE's link to the review history is read — Lakens
  • e47db15 [xml_in_modules] A notice about another article (correction, retraction) is not asked for statements; ethics_check uses the declared ethics statement, with its source; a footnote is a statement only by its declared type or label — Lakens
  • d4f70f2 [xml_in_modules] What an article's metadata declares wins over a text search that finds nothing, and each answer names its source (funding_check, coi_check, open_practices) — Lakens
  • b0611f5 [xml_in_modules] funding_check counts and lists the funders an article declares; open_practices reports the open-science badges the journal awarded (papers read from publisher XML) — Lakens
  • 6db3ce5 [xml_in_modules] repo_check lists the publisher's supplementary files of a paper read from XML, apart from the repositories; downloadable ones go to data_check and code_check, copies of repository files do not; citing sentences are found in bibr 12.x papers too. Version 0.5.1.2 — Lakens
  • ffe9a88 [publisher_xml] Reading publisher XML is a new version: 0.5.1.1 — Lakens
  • 54d7bab [publisher_xml] read() reads publisher XML: JATS, Elsevier, Wiley, BITS, OJS exports, DocBook, Word, OpenDocument, web pages, SciELO markup, PDF and OCR tool output, metadata records (PubMed, Crossref, DOAJ, EndNote, ISC) and journals' own formats, through one route to GROBID's TEI reader; what the XML declares beyond the text is kept as bibr schema 12.6; an author's second affiliation is no longer lost. Version 0.4.4.42 — Lakens
